name: Revolution SummerSlam
Text: Your Pre-match Capacity is +1. Your Revolution Outmaneuver and Revolution You Telegraphed It cards are F: 0. All players' Revolution Hardcore Hell cards are blank.

name: Revolution Suplex City
Text: Requirement: no Corner in your Ring. Put up to 1 non-reversal card with 'suplex' in the title from your Ringside into your hand: put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal. You have 5+ lower Fortitude: this card has Momentum, and you may play it from Ringside.

name: Revolution Survive If I Let You
Text: Requirement: Revolution Beat Me If You Can... in your Ring. Antic: Shuffle up to 13 maneuvers from your Ringside into your Arsenal. Reversal: Ignore the Requirement.

name: Revolution Survivor Series
Text: Your Pre-match Capacity is +1. Your Revolution Outmaneuver and Revolution You Telegraphed It cards are F: 0. All players' Revolution You're Drafted cards are blank.

name: Revolution Swiss Blade
Text: When played after a Core: cannot be reversed from Backlash.

name: Revolution Tajiri
Text: Once during each of your turns, put up to 1 non-Multi non-reversal card with 'kick' in the title from your Ring or Ringside into your hand.

name: Revolution Tajiri's Asian Mist
Text: When this card reverses from Arsenal: put it in your Ring instead.

name: Revolution Tandem Face Stretch
Text: Requirement: Tag Team. Shuffle up to 2 maneuvers from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Revolution Tandem Suplex
Text: Requirement: Tag Team. Your opponent may discard 1 card; if he does not, he overturns 3 cards.

name: Revolution Tarantula
Text: Trademark: -4F, and when played after a Follow-Up: this card has Momentum. When you are Revolution Tajiri and have a non-Revolution card in your Ring: this card is 'Reversal: Card' instead.
Type: Trademark: Core / Reversal: Assault or Extreme

name: Revolution Tazz
Text: Hybrid reversals to your cards with 'plex' or 'choke' in the title deal no damage, and when you have lower Fortitude, those cards cannot be reversed by hybrid reversals. When you have a non-Revolution card in your Ring: your cards with 'plex' or 'choke' in the title are +3D. You cannot pack Corners.

name: Revolution Tazz-Line
Text: Draw up to 1 card. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may put it on the bottom of your Arsenal: draw up to 1 card.

name: Revolution Team X-Treme
Text: When your opponent plays a Mid-match reversal to your printed Follow-up: he discards 1 random card. When he reverses your printed Follow-up, you may put this card into your Ringside and then put 2 non-hybrid maneuvers from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Revolution Testify!
Text: Put up to 1 maneuver from your Ringside into your hand, and shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal; you may allow your opponent to draw 1 card: if you do, shuffle up to 3 additional cards.

name: Revolution That's What I Do!
Text: Your Mid-match Capacity is +1. Search your Arsenal for 1 non-reversal Superstar-specific card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. Once during each of your turns when you have greater Fortitude, you may discard 1 maneuver with blank text:

name: Revolution The 8th Wonder of the World
Text: When you are not a Revolution Superstar: overturn 8 cards. Before the first turn of the game, put any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal: draw up to the same number of cards -1 and then put up to 1 non-unique card from your Ringside into your hand. When you successfully play an Andre the Giant-specific card without Momentum: put up to 1 Backlash card from your Ringside into your Backlash.

name: Revolution The Architect
Text: Shuffle up to 3 non-reversal cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Revolution The Celtic Warrior
Text: Your Pre-match Capacity is +1. When you successfully play an Assault, or when you are a Revolution Superstar and successfully play a Sheamus-specific card: draw up to 1 card.

name: Revolution The Cesaro Swing
Text: Discard up to 3 cards: your opponent overturns double that number of cards.

name: Revolution The Dreadlocked Dynamo
Text: Put up to 3 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal and draw the same number of cards +2. When this card reverses from Arsenal, put it into your Ring. When this card is in your Ring, your Revolution Air Kofi is also 'Reversal: Colossal'.

name: Revolution The FTW Title Belt
Text: Search your Arsenal for up to 2 cards with 'plex' or 'choke' in the title: reveal them, put them in your hand, and shuffle. When you are a Revolution Superstar: your opponent discards 1 card.

name: Revolution The Gore!
Text: Trademark: -10F, and when played after a Superstar-specific or Colossal: this card has Momentum.
Type: Trademark: Colossal / Reversal: Assault or Extreme

name: Revolution The Highlight Reel
Text: Your Pre-match Capacity is +1. During your opponent's turn when he successfully plays a maneuver and you have lower Fortitude, it is not his first maneuver of the turn, and damage has been applied, you may shuffle 3 cards from your hand into your Arsenal: put up to 1 non-hybrid maneuver from your Ringside into your hand and end his turn.

name: Revolution The Hounds of Justice
Text: When you are Revolution The Shield: discard 2 cards, put up to 2 cards from Ringside on top or bottom of your Arsenal, draw up to 3 cards, and your opponent discards 1 card. Reversals to your Trademarks and maneuvers with 'Requirement: Tag Team' deal no damage.

name: Revolution The Hulkster
Text: Successfully play a non-Unique Core: search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique non-hybrid antic, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. When this card is in your Ring, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside: discard your hand and put the same number of cards discarded from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Revolution The Immortal Big Boot
Text: Search your Arsenal and Ringside for Revolution Hulkamania Leg Drop, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. Your next card played is -10F.

name: Revolution The King of Swing
Text: Shuffle up to 3 Cores and up to 3 Colossals from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Revolution The Man!
Text: Discard 1 card and put up to 7 cards from Ringside into your hand. When this card is in your Ring, your opponent's cards are -3D.

name: Revolution The Manbeast
Text: Discard up to 2 cards: draw the same number of cards +1. When you are a Revolution Superstar: your Extremes, Assaults and Foreign Objects are -1F for each Rhyno-specific card in your Ring.

name: Revolution The Milan Miracle
Text: Requirement: 5+ cards in your hand and no Corner in your Ring. Can be played from Ringside. Shuffle 4 cards from your hand, up to 1 non-Unique card in your Ring and up to 6 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal: draw up to 7 cards. Your next card played this turn has Momentum.

name: Revolution The Neutralizer
Text: Trademark: -5F. Your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Revolution The Original WWF Hall of Famer
Text: Put up to # cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal, where # is the number of cards in your Ring with 'Giant' in the title. Successfully play a card with 'legend' in the title or text: put up to 2 cards that do not have 'defense' in the title from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Revolution The Power of Hulkamania
Text: Your opponent discards 1 card.

name: Revolution The Power of the Warrior
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 maneuver of the same type as the reversed card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Revolution The Rock's Sharpshooter
Text: When you have lower Fortitude: -10F. As a maneuver, put up to 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal: put the same number of cards from your Ringside into your hand. As an antic, -10F. Shuffle this card and up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Revolution The Rowdy Sleeper
Text: Trademark: -10F and when successfully played, your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Revolution The Sensei of Mattitude
Text: Can only be packed by Revolution Matt Hardy. Successfully play a non-Backlash Matt Hardy-specific card: put up to 1 non-reversal card from your Ringside on top of your Arsenal and up to 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. Replace the 'actions' text with 'actions and antics' on your Matt Facts.

name: Revolution The Shield
Text: Once during each of your turns you may overturn 3 cards: put up to 1 card with 'Requirement: Tag Team' from your Ringside in your hand. You are a Tag Team. You cannot pack Corners.

name: Revolution The Side Effect
Text: Trademark: -10F and when successfully played, draw up to 1 card. When you are a Revolution Superstar: this card is also 'Reversal: Grapple'.

name: Revolution The Swiss Superman
Text: Put up to 3 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal: draw the same number of cards +1. Your Revolution European Uppercut cards are +4D and Colossals instead.

name: Revolution The Triple Powerbomb
Text: During your turn when this card is in your hand, you may discard it, draw up to 3 cards, and put 2 cards from hand on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Revolution The Ultimate Warrior
Text: Once during each of your turns you may discard 2 cards: put up to 1 non-unique non-hybrid Revolution maneuver from your Ring into hand. When your maneuvers would become Multi, they are +3D instead. You cannot pack Corners or Extremes.

name: Revolution The Wyatt Family
Text: When you completely reverse a maneuver, choose one: draw up to 1 card, or you may search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique non-hybrid maneuver with printed damage equal or less than the reversed card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. You are a Tag Team. You cannot pack Corners.

name: Revolution The YES! Movement
Text: When you have lower Fortitude or fewer cards in hand: this card cannot be reversed by non-Unique reversals, and as a reversal: F: 0. Put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand, and up to 3 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. Name a Target: this card gains that Target.

name: Revolution Van Terminator
Text: Cannot be reversed by hybrid cards, or from Arsenal by non-Unique cards.

name: Revolution Version 1.0
Text: Your Superstar Value is +1 and your Pre-match Capacity is +1. When you are Revolution Matt Hardy: you are an Extremist and when you play an Extreme: Follow-up, you may discard 2 cards and ignore the Follow-up, and when it is successfully played, shuffle 1 non-reversal card in your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Revolution Very European Uppercut
Text: Draw up to 3 cards.

name: Revolution Warrior's Body Slam
Text: This card cannot become Multi. Trademark: -2F. Reversal: -2D.

name: Revolution Warrior's Dash to the Ring
Text: When you are Revolution Ultimate Warrior, before the first Draw Segment of the game you may put this card from your Backlash into your Ring: draw 3 cards and your opponent discards 1 random card. During your turn when this card is in your Backlash or Ring, you may put it into your Ringside and draw 1 card.

name: Revolution Warrior's Running Clothesline
Text: When you discard this card for your Ability: put it on the bottom of your Arsenal instead and draw up to 1 card.

name: Revolution Warrior's Shoulder Block
Text: This card cannot become Multi. Trademark: -4F and when successfully played, draw up to 2 cards.

name: Revolution Warrior's Ultimate Press Drop
Text: Search your Arsenal and Ringside for Revolution Warrior's Ultimate Splash, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Revolution Warrior's Ultimate Splash
Text: When successfully played after a maneuver: Your opponent discards 3 cards.

name: Revolution Wazzzzzup!!
Text: When played after a successfully played maneuver: cannot be reversed from Backlash or by hybrid cards from hand. Draw up to 2 cards and then discard 1 card: your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Revolution We're Here
Text: Draw up to 1 card. Your opponent puts his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal and draws the same number of cards.

name: Revolution We're Taking Over!
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 antic, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. When you unsuccessfuly play an antic and overturn cards for not playing a maneuver: put up to 3 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you have a non-Revolution card in your Ring: replace 'antic' with 'antic or action' in your Ability.

name: Revolution We, The People!
Text: Draw up to 4 cards. When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, your Fortitude Rating is 10-, and your maneuver is reversed, you may put this card into your Ring, that maneuver is considered successful, your turn does not end, and your next card played cannot be reversed from hand by non-Unique cards.

name: Revolution Whatcha Gonna Do, Brother?
Text: Draw up to 2 cards and look at your opponent's hand. When you are a Revolution Superstar, choose 1 card in his hand and he discards the chosen card.

name: Revolution Who's Next?
Text: When you are Revolution Goldberg: this card is also 'Reversal: Action'. Your next maneuver played is -7F and has Momentum.

name: Revolution Wrestlemania
Text: Your Pre-match Capacity is +1. Your Revolution Outmaneuver and Revolution You Telegraphed It cards are F: 0. All players' Revolution 4ever: No Mercy cards are blank.

name: Revolution WWE's Extremely Charismatic Wrestlers
Logos: Big Show, Christian, Jack Swagger, Kurt Angle, The Largest Athlete in Sports Entertainment, The Leader of the Peepulation, William Regal, Your Freaking Hero
Text: You can pack this card regardless of Superstar. When your logo is not on this card, you have greater Fortitude, and you play a Mid-match reversal: discard 1 random card. When your logo is on this card: your Pre-match Capacity is +1 and you may ignore the Requirement on your Revolution Overexposure when you do not have a card with that title in your Ring.

name: Revolution WWE's Powerhouses
Logos: Brock Lesnar, Beast Incarnate, Mark Henry, Great Khali, Test, Umaga
Text: You can pack this card regardless of Superstar. Draw up to 1 card. When your logo is printed on this card: you are a Powerhouse. When you are a Powerhouse: look at the top 5 cards of your Arsenal: put them in any order on the top and/or bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Revolution X-Treme Initiative
Text: Requirement: Revolution Incredible High Flyers is in your Ring. Put up to 1 Follow-up with a title not in your Ring from your Ringside into your hand and draw up to 1 card. When your next card played this turn is a Follow-up, you may ignore the Follow-up. When your logo is on Revolution Incredible High Flyers and your next card played this turn is a Follow-up, it is +3D and when you have lower Fortitude: it has Momentum.

name: Revolution Ziggler's Famous-er
Text: When played as a Counter, -5F and +5D. Put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand.
